notes.text: Bringing DEP01-A back online — first I'll size up the hold and failure risks.
Wet clean with seasoning done — old recipe will likely run thick. Checking history for drift patterns.
History shows clean-only recoveries settle flat with seasoned first wafers. Now checking metrology matching.
MET02 reads about 7 Å high while MET01 is on target. I'll run a seasoned baseline monitor on MET01.
First monitor reads a touch thin at 494 Å. I'll run a second to confirm before setting the recipe.
Two monitors agree tightly, so the rate is solid. Now estimating the on-target recipe time.
Rate confirmed on the accurate tool and old recipe shown thick — ready to release at the estimated target.
